Sandbox_TienInspectWeapon_InspectSeconds: Seconds of real time the character spends bringing the weapon up and looking it over before the window opens, at normal game speed. A firearm takes a quarter longer, and every level of Maintenance takes 2.5 percent off. The game lengthens any timed action further for an unhappy, drunk, cold or wounded character, so this is the baseline rather than a guarantee.
Sandbox_TienInspectWeapon_MaxHoldSeconds: How long the character will keep looking the weapon over before giving up on their own, in seconds of real time at normal game speed. Almost anything ends it sooner: closing the window, pressing the key again, breaking into a run, raising the weapon, or starting any other action. Not used in Persistent Window mode, where the window stays until it is closed.
Sandbox_TienInspectWeapon_PersistentWind: Off: the character holds the weapon up for as long as the window is open, and running, raising the weapon, starting another action or putting the weapon away closes it. On: the character raises the weapon and studies it for the Time To Raise Weapon, then the window opens and the character carries on as normal. The window then stays open through anything - other actions, running, fighting, swapping weapons - until it is closed with its close button or by pressing the inspect key again. It keeps describing the weapon that was inspected for as long as the character is carrying it.
